sentences.en: Kipper wanted new shoes.
sentences.zh: Kipper 想要新的鞋。

sentences.en: He couldn't tie his laces.
sentences.zh: 他不能题额他的花边。

sentences.en: Dad helped him.
sentences.zh: 爸爸帮助他。

sentences.en: Kipper was at school.
sentences.zh: Kipper 是在学校。

sentences.en: Kipper couldn't tie his laces.
sentences.zh: Kipper 不能题额他的花边。

sentences.en: Miss Green helped him.
sentences.zh: 小姐绿色的帮助他。

sentences.en: Kipper was upset.
sentences.zh: Kipper 是使苦恼。

sentences.en: He told Dad.
sentences.zh: 他告诉爸爸。

sentences.en: Dad made a block.
sentences.zh: 爸爸做一个大块。

sentences.en: Kipper tried... and tried...
sentences.zh: Kipper 经过考验的。。。 和经过考验的。。。

sentences.en: and tried and tried. said Kipper.
sentences.zh: 和经过考验的和经过考验的。 说 Kipper。

sentences.en: He did up his laces.
sentences.zh: 他做向上他的花边。

sentences.en: "Oh no!" said Kipper.
sentences.zh: 哦不！ 说 Kipper。

sentences.en: This game helps the child to recognise capital letters.
sentences.zh: 这个游戏帮助这孩子到认出大写字母信。

sentences.en: Look through the book and find words with capital letters.
sentences.zh: 看穿过这书和找到单词和……一起大写字母信。

sentences.en: Notice whether the capital letters are used to begin a sentence or a name.
sentences.zh: 布告是否这大写字母信是我们到开始一个句子或者一个名字。

sentences.en: Choose one of the capital letters and ask the child to find it and show it to you.
sentences.zh: 选择一的这大写字母信和问这孩子到找到它和展示它到你。

sentences.en: Then the child chooses a capital letter and asks you to find it.
sentences.zh: 然后这孩子选择一个大写字母信和问你到找到它。

sentences.en: Have two or three turns each.
sentences.zh: 有二或者三转动每个。

sentences.en: You can use these ideas straight away, or on another day.
sentences.zh: 你能使用这些主意直的离开， 或者在……上另一个一天。

sentences.en: • Look at the letters on the blackboard on page 5 of the story.
sentences.zh: • 看在这信在……上这黑板在……上页 5 的这故事。

sentences.en: Say the alphabet together, putting in the letters that you cannot see on the page.
sentences.zh: 说这字母表一起， 放在……里这信那个你 cannot 看见在……上这页。

sentences.en: If the child has trouble doing up laces, use a block or a shoe to practise.
sentences.zh: 如果这孩子有问题做向上花边， 使用一个大块或者一个鞋到练习。

sentences.en: Give plenty of praise for trying.
sentences.zh: 给大量的称赞为了令人厌烦的。
